headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 6, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners dominated the Detroit Tigers, securing a 4-0 victory behind Bryce Miller's 6.0 innings of shutout baseball. In other action, the Kansas City Royals edged the Minnesota Twins 3-2, and the St. Louis Cardinals outlasted the Cincinnati Reds 6-5.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with the Los Angeles Angels placing Jack Kochanowicz on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Milwaukee Brewers also suffered a blow, placing Quinn Priester on the 60-day injured list with right thoracic outlet syndrome. Other notable injuries include Tyler Glasnow's transfer to the 60-day injured list with low back spasms and Austin Wells' placement on the 10-day injured list with cervical headaches.

Several teams made roster moves, including the Chicago Cubs, who acquired LHP Antoine Kelly from the Los Angeles Dodgers. The Milwaukee Brewers also made a trade, acquiring RHP Joel Kuhnel from the Athletics for cash. The Boston Red Sox traded for LHP Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates, while the Cincinnati Reds traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Out Tigers 4-0**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Detroit Tigers, securing a 4-0 victory. Bryce Miller led the way on the mound, pitching 6.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Twins in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals took down the Minnesota Twins 3-2, with Carter Jensen leading the offense and Matt Strahm earning the win.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Edge Reds in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals outlasted the Cincinnati Reds 6-5, securing a hard-fought victory. Matt McLain led the Reds with a home run and two RBIs, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Cardinals' late-game surge.

top_news.title: **Giants Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs edged the San Francisco Giants 3-2, securing a narrow victory. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dropped a 2-3 decision to the Atlanta Braves in their latest matchup. Spencer Horwitz was a notable performer for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 5-9 victory over the Chicago White Sox in their latest matchup. Impact hitters for the Phillies included Bryce Harper, Brandon Marsh, and Alec Bohm, while Randal Grichuk and Tristan Peters led the charge for the White Sox.

top_news.title: **Angels RHP Jack Kochanowicz Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels right-hander Jack Kochanowicz has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Kelly Heads to Wrigley**
top_news.summary: Antoine Kelly, a left-handed pitcher, has been traded to the Chicago Cubs. The Los Angeles Dodgers dealt Kelly to the Cubs in a trade.
